marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Tuck into some Ratatouille, spend the day at Monsters Inc., head Up into the sky in a magical house pulled by balloons, and who could forget Toy Story? Featuring over 200 of your favourite characters, "Disney Pixar Character Encyclopedia" takes you through them all, one page at a time. Young (and not so young) Disney Pixar fans will find this A to Z reference guide totally addictive and easy to use. It packs the whole of the Disney Pixar world, from "Toy Story" to 2012's "Brave", into one compact, portable volume for the first time. So whether you can't stop watching "A Bug's Life", "Finding Nemo or Wall E", "Disney Pixar Character Encyclopedia" will tell you all you need to know with great images and fascinating facts. "The Disney Pixar Character Encyclopedia" is a must have for all Disney Pixar fans.
